name: Index ETF Covered Call Overwrite
summary: Systematically write monthly calls against a held index ETF position (SPY/QQQ/IWM) - the retail version of the CBOE BXM buy-write index.

legs.strike_rule: Delta 0.25-0.35, or the first strike 2-4% OTM
legs.dte_rule: 30-35 DTE, written on a fixed monthly schedule

max_profit: (strike - cost basis + credit) x 100 per cycle; historically BXM has captured roughly index-like returns with lower volatility and a capped right tail
max_loss: Full index downside minus credits - a covered call is a poor hedge, cushioning only about one month of premium

greeks.vega: negative - the structure is short volatility, which is why it underperforms in vol spikes and outperforms in grinding markets

when_to_use: As a systematic income overlay on a core index holding. Best when IVR > 25 and the market is range-bound. Underperforms badly in strong bull runs.
entry_rules: Hold 100 shares of SPY/QQQ/IWM per contract; coverage verified at order time
Write on a fixed schedule: the Monday after monthly opex, targeting the next monthly expiry (30-35 DTE)
Skip the cycle if IVR < 15 - the credit does not pay for the capped upside
Skip if the ETF's ex-distribution date is within 3 days of expiry and the call is ITM
Credit >= 0.8% of share value per 30-day cycle
management_rules: Buy to close at 50% of credit or at 21 DTE, whichever first, then wait for the next scheduled write
Roll up and out when delta exceeds 0.60, for a net credit only
Do not chase: if the index gaps above the strike, accept the capped outcome rather than rolling at a debit into a worse strike
Measure realised annualised yield each quarter against simple buy-and-hold; discontinue if the overlay has cost more in capped upside than it earned over a rolling 12 months
exit_rules: Buy to close at 50% of credit or 21 DTE

NEVER-ASSIGN RULE: close or roll when extrinsic < $0.10, delta > 0.85, before any ex-distribution date where extrinsic < the distribution, or by 14:30 ET on expiration day if within 1.0% of the strike. Backstop 15:45 ET
SPY and QQQ pay quarterly distributions - the pre-ex-dividend check must run on the quarterly schedule
assignment_risk: MODERATE. Index ETF calls are assigned early mainly around quarterly ex-distribution dates. Assignment sells the covered shares - not a loss, but an unplanned exit that breaks position accounting.
liquidity_needs: Excellent - SPY/QQQ chains are penny-wide with enormous OI.
common_mistakes: Running the overlay through a bull market and wondering why the account lags the index; treating a covered call as downside protection, which it is not.
